sources: recreation.gov public search API campsite catalog for facility 232773 (28 sites), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 232773 (all 28 sites typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC / GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC, no electric/water/sewer attributes), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 28 sites including two group sites, three accessible. Forest Service 'Max Trailer Length: 55ft'; recreation.gov catalog lengths run 25-50 ft (one site is car/tent only).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/parkside-campground-and-group-campsites ('Camp sites: 28, including both reservable sites and first come first serve sites', 'Max Trailer Length : 55ft') + recreation.gov catalog for 232773, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water (hand pump) only during the operating season. Trash goes to Greenough Lake Campground. Firewood $7/bundle from the host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232773 ('accessible vault toilets and drinking water', amenity 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Trash can be deposited at the Greenough Lake Campground') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/parkside-campground-and-group-campsites ('Potable water is only available during the operating season', 'Firewood: Yes- $7.00 / bundle'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open year-round. Fees charged Memorial Day - Labor Day.' Full service May 26 - September 8; outside those dates the campground is 'ungated, free, and available for use (no services, not maintained, roads are not plowed)', so bring water and pack out trash. recreation.gov: 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/parkside-campground-and-group-campsites (Seasons of Use; 'May 26-September 8th-Full service'; 'Reduced service in shoulder season'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $20 a single site including one vehicle; $10 each additional vehicle (paid to the host on arrival); $6 day-use fee over half an hour. Fees are charged Memorial Day - Labor Day only; the shoulder season is free with no services.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/parkside-campground-and-group-campsites ('Single Site: $20 per night', '$20.00 includes 1 driving vehicle', '$10 each additional vehicle', '$6 day use campground fee for over 1/2 hour') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232773/rates (2026 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/parkside-campground-and-group-campsites ('1/2 price fees with Interagency Senior and Access Pass holders'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concession-run by Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA) under Forest Service permit. Mix of reservable (recreation.gov, until 2 days before arrival) and first-come sites; first-come sites 'must be booked in person. DO NOT call to determine availability.' A reserved site is held 24 hours past check-in. 16-day maximum in all Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/parkside-campground-and-group-campsites ('Under concessionaire permit with Recreation Resource Management of America', 'There is a 16 day maximum stay in all Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232773 (notices; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 2; catalog 4 of 28 sites not reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Custer Gallatin National Forest (Beartooth Ranger District) campground on the banks of the Main Fork of Rock Creek, ~12 mi south of Red Lodge at the base of the Beartooth Highway (US-212) switchbacks, 0.4 mi up Main Fork Rock Creek Rd (FR 2421). Aspen and pine; Greenough Lake under a mile away. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 28 sites (55-ft max trailer), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, $20 (2026), recreation.gov with some first-come sites. Changed season closes 09-10 (derived from the rec.gov calendar) -> year_round (FS: 'Open year-round. Fees charged Memorial Day - Labor Day', free and unserviced outside). Added 16-night limit, RRMA concession, senior/access half price for this campground. Not stated: booking window (180 inherited left). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Phone: the entry has 406-587-6710 (Custer Gallatin Supervisor's Office). The Forest Service page names the concessionaire Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA), (928) 537-8888, which recreation.gov also gives; recreation.gov's facility phone is 406-587-9054.

Waterfront re-audit lead: Forest Service and recreation.gov both say the campground is 'along/on the banks of the Main Fork of Rock Creek' and recreation.gov lists 'Waterfront Sites' and 'River Access'; the entry is 'riverview'.
